text: Just conflicted with what do I do? Do I yell to try to shake up the convo? Do I keep listening so I know everything? And I just hung up because it got too painful. Some of you know the pain of that kind of betrayal. I've had people tell me that they've had screenshots of texts they've sent sent back to them on accident. Essentially, they can tell that that screenshot was meant to be for some group text or some other one, and they realize that people are talking about me.
